purpose: For every locally represented daily symbol/session pair in the four-hour dataset date range, classify missing four-hour morning/afternoon bars and exact same-symbol/date daily OHLCV availability.

data_source_policy.four_hour: User-provided local CSV export of the existing 4-hour source; no production credentials or live Google Sheets access.
data_source_policy.daily: Already cached local daily OHLCV CSV; no network retrieval or Yahoo scraping.
data_source_policy.calendar: Frozen local XTKS official session CSV.
data_source_policy.runtime: Ordinary local Python only; standard library; no Codex, LLM, API, paid service, or external notification.

key: Normalized symbol plus official XTKS session date.

expected_intraday_slots.complete_day: Exactly one valid bar in each expected slot and no unexpected-slot or duplicate rows

population: All unique symbol/session rows present in the local daily OHLCV source within the audited date span, plus observed four-hour-only keys. This cannot discover a symbol/session absent from both sources without a separate point-in-time listing universe.
outputs: missing_four_hour_symbol_sessions.csv, including daily OHLCV and availability status
summary.json with input hashes, coverage counts, and scope limitations
prohibited: Fetching any external data or using production credentials
Filling, forward-filling, or synthesizing hourly/four-hour values from daily OHLCV
Treating daily price availability as proof of intraday signal feature availability or executable fill
Inferring symbol/session pairs absent from both supplied datasets
